label: DUI Arrest Without Probable Cause
motion_heading: The Arrest for Driving Under the Influence Was Not Supported by Probable Cause

review_conditions.display_note: You aren't sure yet whether probable cause for the DUI arrest holds up. This section was drafted anyway; review the officer's observations, the field sobriety tests, and any video before filing, or cut this section.

rule_statements.text: A warrantless arrest is lawful only if the officer has probable cause to believe that the person arrested has committed a crime.

Probable cause exists only where the facts and circumstances within the officer's knowledge, based on reasonably trustworthy information, are sufficient to warrant a prudent person in believing that the person arrested had committed an offense.
